chapter: Gene Mayl, Teddy Buckner and the Dixie Flies
title: Joining Teddy Buckner's band and Gene Norman records
summary: Back in Los Angeles Joe replaced Pud Brown in Teddy Buckner's band and made albums with Gene Norman.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: I want to help to... You came back to Los Angeles...
...finally, and played with the Young Men...
When did you play with The Young Men From New Orleans?
Just before I went with Louis.
I'm trying now to get into Louis.
Yes. I come back here, and Teddy had left Ory.
Yes. So we went into... I went into Teddy's band. I replaced Pud Brown.
And that's when you made those records, the ones with...
That's when we made Gene Norman's records, those...
Do Lord, Oh Do Lord and all that stuff.
Yeah, that's right. That was Frank (?) and Gene Norman...
